ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this ruling is on the platform's own GPS trace and fare ledger, both at full weight, and it does not change the charge line on which the trip was billed.

The deviation is established. The governing distance is the trace figure, gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 14.44 km, not the rounded 14.4 km on the trip record. Against the booked optimal of 12.0 km the excess is 2.44 km, which is 20.33% of the optimal and also clears the 0.8 km absolute bar, so both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass. The excess is below the 8.0 km and 50% materiality figures, so this is not a MATERIAL deviation and no POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is triggered on materiality.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes. It carries 114 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of the POL-RD-07(a) to (c) limbs fires and the excess may be established on the trace alone; no independent corroboration is required.

The driver's explanation - 'minor detour because of a road works sign' - is an assertion of an external traffic cause and is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. The bundle holds no advisory covering this window: EV-ADVIS-02818-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload. The POL-RD-03 comparison therefore cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver named no advisory evidence ID, this is a gap in the bundle and not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged and the case is decided on the measured excess rather than escalated. The measured excess stands at 2.44 km. (The rider's and driver's claims about the missing advisory were discarded at the mechanical citation stage because they cited the impaired artifact without naming its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code; I have not reinstated them, but the same point is reached here through the surviving POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-08 material.)

No other exculpatory clause applies. The chat log carries zero messages, so there is no rider instruction, no waypoint and no named road, and POL-RD-04 is unavailable. The trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and the booked 12.0 km optimal stands. vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not displace the baseline.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, and the fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not apply. Read from the fare breakdown: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 12.0 optimal distance + 0.28 x 16.0 optimal duration) x surge 1.0, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 surcharge + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = 18.08. Charged total = 20.66. Refund = 20.66 - 18.08 = 2.58, before rounding. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, so NO_ACTION does not apply, and it is 12.5% of charged_total, far below the 90% full-refund share, so PARTIAL_REFUND applies. Rounding the payable figure up to the nearest SGD 0.05 gives SGD 2.60.

No ERP or surcharge correction is due under POL-RD-09: the fare breakdown carries zero ERP gantries, an off-optimal-route ERP total of 0.00, an on-optimal-route total of 0.00, no airport surcharge line, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport. Nothing is added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure, and no billing-integrity referral arises.

No repeat-deviation pattern is established: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1, below the 3-flag threshold, and 1 over 188 completed_trips_90d is 0.0053, far below the 0.05 ratio limb. So there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) driver-conduct referral. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the trailing-90-day figure the clause asks for and has not been used. On the rider's side, deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so no extra corroboration hurdle applies.

Confidence is 0.9. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts - the GPS trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown - is at weight_multiplier 1.0, so nothing discounts the finding. The monetary effect of SGD 2.60 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling may be executed automatically; either party may appeal it once under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
